blends.name: GJ-1 Collector Badge (Common)
blends.desc:
#### Collection badge for the first ever issue of Galaxy Jumper!

This badge will be both a collectable and a stakable asset in p2e partner platforms with MetaForce Comics.  Holding it may also entitle you to special drops from MetaForce Comics.

Galaxy Jumper - An Alien Worlds Adventure is a comic book series that takes place in the Alien Worlds metaverse.

Join the community to learn more about Galaxy Jumper.

blends.name: MF1 Common Variant
blends.desc:
#### MetaForce's first issue!
First of it's kind fully decentralized, fully readable, page turn comic book! This blend allows you to turn your base Common comic "Variant A" into a Rare Variant B or Rare Variant C cover.  These variant covers are at a reduced number and are more rare than the base Variant A cover.

##### Ingrediants
1 - Common Base Comic "Variant A"
1 - 1 $CMX Token

##### Result
60% Common Comic Variant B
40% Common Comic Variant C

Crafting: [https://neftyblocks.com/c/metaforce/blends](https://neftyblocks.com/c/metaforce/blends)

Read your comics here!
